# Unbrowse client

Hosted website execution through remote MCP, CLI and TypeScript SDK.

- [Install](https://github.com/unbrowse-ai/unbrowse-skill/blob/main/docs/install.md): choose an interface and authenticate.
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/unbrowse-ai/unbrowse-skill/blob/main/skill/SKILL.md): execution order, requirements, login handoffs and verified outcomes.
- [MCP](https://github.com/unbrowse-ai/unbrowse-skill/blob/main/docs/mcp.md): remote server and workspace tools.
- [CLI](https://github.com/unbrowse-ai/unbrowse-skill/blob/main/docs/cli.md): commands and exit codes.
- [SDK](https://github.com/unbrowse-ai/unbrowse-skill/blob/main/docs/sdk.md): supported REST methods.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/unbrowse-ai/unbrowse-skill/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): recovery and version selection.

Server: https://unbrowse.ai/mcp
The skill supplies guidance, not authentication. Never infer current site support from examples. Use tools/list and discovery.
